intro: This Guildrun tier list ranks the strongest team builds for Demo 0.5.7 first — full comps with heroes, items, and relics — then adds a hero power ranking so you can judge shop picks. Open a build card for the loadout snapshot, or jump to hero grades when you only need a letter.
methodology: Build tiers weigh clear win conditions, shop consistency, Red Rift / climb reliability, and how complete the published loadout is (heroes + items + relics).
S-tier builds are copyable plans that win often when you follow the shop rules; A-tier needs a cleaner seed or tighter execution; B-tier is situational or greedier.
Hero tiers remain a separate shop-aid: kit ceiling, opener reliability, relic hooks, and whether the hero creates a plan without perfect RNG.
Current Demo 0.5.7 balance and kit read (abilities, specializations, class tags).
Survivability and who eats first contact — fragile carries drop if they cannot be walled.
Beginner accessibility: comps and heroes that teach the run loop without punishing every mistake.

faq.question: What is the best build in Guildrun right now?
faq.answer: On Demo 0.5.7, start with the S-tier build cards on this page — Rush Duelists for Rush shops, Aria Stall Mage for Mage / Stall lines, and Irini Starter when you want a simpler first-clear plan. Open the full build for items, relics, and positioning.

faq.question: Is the Guildrun tier list for builds or heroes?
faq.answer: Both. The main section ranks team builds (the comps you actually play). The hero rankings below are a shop aid when you only need to know if a hero is worth buying.

faq.question: What is the best hero in Guildrun?
faq.answer: There is no single best hero for every shop. S-tier heroes like Nyx, Irini, and Pimenta show up often in strong clears — but only when you cover their jobs (tank for Nyx, Rush partners for Irini, a carry behind Pimenta). Pair the hero grade with a build card.

faq.question: Who is the strongest Guildrun hero?
faq.answer: Nyx has one of the highest damage ceilings when protected early and fed Rush resets. Irini is often stronger as a first-clear or flexible carry. For pure frontline, Pimenta and Rowan stabilize boards that otherwise wipe.

faq.question: What is S Tier in Guildrun?
faq.answer: For builds, S Tier means a complete, repeatable plan that wins often when you follow the shop rules. For heroes, S Tier means the unit consistently wins runs with a sensible supporting cast — not a free win without items or positioning.

faq.question: How often is the Guildrun tier list updated?
faq.answer: We update when Demo balance or our testing notes change. The version label, last-updated date, and changelog near the top of this page show which patch the rankings reflect.

weaknesses: Collapses if she dies first every fight

weaknesses: Low solo clear without a carry behind her

entries.summary: Back-line dual-debuff Mage that melts packs when Mana Regen and Stall/Burn lines are online.
weaknesses: Dies to dive without a wall

entries.summary: Shields, healing, and clutch resurrection — turns long Red Rift fights in your favor.
weaknesses: Quiet early if fights end instantly

entries.summary: High-HP Vanguard that converts Rush into Max HP pressure and enables Duelist partners.
Self-shielding Warrior who holds the line while learning shop timing — staple of starter comps.
Economy and Shield Mystic who stabilizes boards without needing perfect damage relics.
Vanguard/Tank Fault Line anchor — Max HP smash and frontal Stun for hard content.
weaknesses: Needs a carry behind the wall

entries.summary: Shield and zone control that wins when packs stay inside the plan.
weaknesses: Weak if fights are pure Rush races

entries.summary: Packed-enemy Burn carry — spikes when Stall or Burn relics keep stacks cooking.
Adjacent Burn aura that doubles on Rush — frontliner who also pays damage.
Shield-powered melee Warrior — solid when Bloodshield/Aegis lines are online.
Execution axe that grows from damage dealt — mid-front finisher, not a sniper.
Killshot farthest-target Assassin — excellent when Crit and a real front line exist.
Ranged Duelist Frost applicator — flex carry when you need status without full melee greed.
Sanctuary zone that Poisons and Shields — wins on Stall boards that hold bodies in the field.
Come At Me! redirects focus — excellent peel when Stall/Defense are real.
Item-consuming Vanguard engine — spikes runs that can feed him economy loops.
Devour Omnivamp finisher — strong when kills land, empty when he never starts the loop.
Lowest-HP shuriken leap — high ceiling with Crit/Poison, poor as wave-one damage.

Short-range Frost Mage — situational formation support, rarely the run-defining pickup.
Crit-scaling Stone Skin hybrid — greedy pools; strong only when Crit and tank stats both arrive.

buildEntries.summary: Rip converts Rush into Max HP while Nyx and Irini turn every Rush window into attack-speed snowball — the default Demo climb / Red Rift engine.
buildEntries.whyTier: Highest floor when Rush banners appear: clear shop filter, multiple scalers, and a published item + relic package you can follow fight-to-fight.

buildEntries.summary: Aria channels Requiem Barrage through packs while Reyna holds contact and Pollen keeps Stall online for permanent Magic.
buildEntries.whyTier: Best Mage win condition on Demo 0.5.7 when beam geometry is correct — Stall snowball plus a real wall answers long Red Rift fights.

buildEntries.summary: Forgiving first-clear board: Irini stacks attack speed, Nyx refreshes Rush, Reyna holds the front while you learn shop timing.
buildEntries.whyTier: Teaches the Demo loop without greedy triple-carry drafts, still spikes hard enough for climb once Rush uptime is real.

buildEntries.summary: Fiona and Pollen layer shields / sustain; Grace recovers lost fights after Stall or wipe threats.
buildEntries.whyTier: Excellent stabilizer and attrition plan, but needs borrowed damage or a fourth recruit before it clears bosses cleanly.

buildEntries.summary: Reyna and Logan build a Warrior front that lives through contact; Kai turns shields and survival into finishing damage.
buildEntries.whyTier: Very sturdy when Warrior / Shield shops appear, slower clear speed if you never find a finisher spike.

buildEntries.summary: Hoyoung and Yuuna delete priority targets; Zuri bridges frontline durability with Crit-scaling hybrid pressure.
buildEntries.whyTier: High burst when Crit / Assassin relics arrive early, fragile to AoE and dive if the wall never shows — more seed-dependent than S comps.
